epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce entity structural validation errors from >5% to <1%
requirements: R1: Validate and store protocol-specific attributes such as procedural steps and author approvals.
R2: Validate and store data-specific structures such as sample metrics and collection parameters.

slices.title: Patch data model and API for protocols and data
slices.jtbd: When implementing the new entities for this epic, I want to patch the existing Java service and database schema, so that protocols and data can be stored and queried.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a user submits a new protocol, When the backend receives the details, Then it validates and stores protocol-specific attributes.
Given a user uploads epidemiological data, When the backend receives the data, Then it validates and stores data-specific structures.
Given the QA requirements, When tests are executed, Then unit, integration, and E2E tests for the new entities pass successfully.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: increase test coverage of protocol and data entities from <50% to >90%

epics.title: Protocol and Material Versioning History
epics.jtbd: When an epidemiological protocol or material description is updated, I want the system to track previous versions and maintain a revision history, so that I can audit changes and revert to older versions.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce untracked material changes from 100% to 0%
requirements: R1: Track previous versions and maintain revision history for protocols and materials.
R2: Provide the ability to view a list of historical revisions showing who changed what and when.

slices.title: Implement version tracking for protocols and materials
slices.jtbd: When implementing versioning for this epic, I want to add history tracking to the existing backend endpoints, so that material updates are preserved.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing protocol is edited and saved, When the save endpoint is called, Then a new revision is stored.
Given a user requests the history of a protocol, When they view the detailed page, Then they can see a list of historical revisions.
Given the QA requirements, When tests are executed, Then unit, integration, and E2E tests for revision history pass.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: increase revision record creation rate from 0% to 100%

slices.title: Fix launch and health check failure
slices.jtbd: When implementing the runtime fix for this epic, I want to patch the container configuration or startup scripts, so that the health check passes.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
